title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 7 keeps the revision 6 diagnostics and adds a deliberately narrow active experiment based on two real-TV captures: when AdBlock is enabled and a parsed response consists exactly of responseContext, trackingParams, and isAdPlayback=true, GTV preserves the response envelope but changes only isAdPlayback to false before YouTube consumes it. The diagnostics observer runs first, so the original true event remains visible in the on-TV report. Normal player responses, nested isAdPlayback fields, false states, and objects with any extra top-level fields are left untouched.
